description: VN→ZH 'de' particle confusion: the three homophonous particles 的/得/地 collapse for learners. After a verb, a manner/degree complement needs 得, not attributive 的 — '他跑得快', not '他跑的快'. Rule zh-de-verb-complement rewrites 的 → 得 between a closed verb and a closed single-char complement at clause end.
fp_risk_note: Low-medium risk. Rewrites 的 → 得 only between a closed verb (跑走说写吃唱做来去睡笑画飞读想) and a closed single-char manner/degree complement (快慢好早晚对多清楚) at clause end. The nominalizer/attributive 的 before a noun ('我说的话' = the words I said) and possessive 的 ('这是我的') never match because the following token is a noun, not a complement.

positive.notes: 跑的快 → 跑得快 (manner complement).
说的好 → 说得好 (degree complement).
来的早 → 来得早 (degree complement).

negative.notes: Nominalizer/attributive 的 before a noun (话 = words) — 'the words I said', 的 is correct, must abstain.
Already 得 — must not touch, must abstain.
Possessive 的 ('this is mine') — must abstain.
